description: Defines the ExpenseLineChart widget, which renders a responsive line chart for expense and income data in a Flutter application, utilizing the fl_chart package for chart rendering.

classes.name: ExpenseLineChart
classes.description: A Flutter widget that renders a dynamic, responsive line chart to visualize expense and income time series data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the expense line chart, handling empty data placeholders and chart rendering with customized axes, tooltips, and styling.

methods.name: _toEpochDay
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to an epoch day number for plotting on the X-axis.

methods.name: _fmtDateFromEpochDay
methods.description: Formats an epoch day number into a 'YYYY-MM-DD' date string for display on the axes.

methods.name: _niceInterval
methods.description: Calculates a human-friendly interval value for Y-axis grid lines based on maximum Y value.

methods.name: _xInterval
methods.description: Determines an appropriate X-axis interval for labels based on the span between minX and maxX.

methods.name: _axisLabel
methods.description: Generates a widget for axis labels, formatted based on whether it's a Y-axis or X-axis label.
